method.assembly: Assemble each row left-to-right, then join complete rows top-to-bottom.
method.cost: Mean squared RGB difference in 0..255 sample units; no alpha cost.
method.dp: Minimum accumulated cost, predecessor offsets -1,0,+1; deterministic first-minimum tie breaking.
method.feather: Linear incoming weight clip((coordinate - seam + 3)/6,0,1); rounded RGB.
method.resize: Uniform LANCZOS cover, top-left anchored. PIL floating source box implements exact scale and right/bottom crop without integer aspect drift.

frozen_matte.preprocessing: Temporary 10-pixel pure-green border around composite; extract on padded image, then crop border. Frozen tool unchanged.

alpha_method.method: green excess matte + inverse straight-alpha compositing + nearest fully-opaque RGB clamp
green excess matte + inverse straight-alpha compositing + nearest fully-opaque RGB clamp

mist.alpha_method: alpha=max(R,G,B), straight RGB=RGB*255/alpha where alpha>0, clipped, then alpha*=0.85; nearest integer quantization.

concerns: Terrain composites do not meet the frozen character matte border precondition directly; a temporary pure-green border is added in memory and cropped after extraction.
The CS-asm-fg implementation was not among the supplied readable inputs; the seam algorithm implements the RGB-cost, DP +/-1 and feather +/-3 specification in this task.
Wrapper-owned live audit files (.wrapper-events.jsonl and .wrapper-stderr.txt) are excluded from deliverable hashes.

observations: The requested unequal layer extents expose black to the right of the sky and beyond the terrain in the full-extent top-left stack preview.
Mist delivered alpha peaks at 220 after LANCZOS resampling; the prescribed 0.85 multiplier was applied before resizing.
